name: Whispers of the Peaks
description: Kinnaree scouts report a growing darkness emanating from the Crystal Caves. Strange whispers drive travelers mad.

node_01.name: Crystal Cave Entrance
node_01.base_description: The air grows cold and thin as you approach the cave mouth. Strange, crystalline formations shimmer with an unnatural light, and faint, disembodied whispers seem to slither into your mind.
node_01.lore_fragment: The Kinnaree speak of these peaks as sacred grounds, but a growing darkness corrupts their ancient magic.

node_02.name: Whispering Grotto
node_02.base_description: The whispers intensify here, echoing off the jagged crystal walls. Shadows writhe in the periphery, and the very air feels heavy with dread. A faint, sickly sweet scent hangs in the air.
node_02.lore_fragment: These cultists twist the natural energies of Himmapan, drawing power from the encroaching void. Their chants are a perversion of sacred incantations.

node_03.name: Chasm of Echoes
node_03.base_description: A deep chasm splits the cave floor, spanned only by a precarious, ancient bridge made of woven vines and glowing moss. The whispers here are a cacophony, threatening to overwhelm reason.
node_03.lore_fragment: The Kinnaree once used these bridges to traverse the treacherous peaks. Now, they crumble under the weight of the encroaching darkness.
node_03.puzzle_obstacle: A rickety vine bridge spans a bottomless chasm, its integrity questionable.

node_04.name: The Crystal Heart
node_04.base_description: At the heart of the cave, a massive, pulsating crystal emanates a palpable aura of corruption. Twisted figures writhe around it, their forms contorted by the dark energy. The whispers coalesce into a single, malevolent voice.
node_04.lore_fragment: This crystal is a nexus of Saiyasart, twisted by an unknown entity. The Kinnaree fear it will shatter the balance of Himmapan.
